line: Bitcoin holds steady as outflows persist and security breaches combine with regulatory friction in major markets.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -0.15% on the day, spot ETF net -137.9M USD (Oct 23, 2026), Fear & Greed 50 (neutral), funding +0.0100% per 8h (warm)

wire_top3.line: CoinDCX lost $16M from retired wallets after CEO Sumit Gupta had denied breach reports as a false alarm.
UK banks received 10,000 complaints in three months over crypto purchase restrictions, conflicting with the nation's crypto hub aspirations.
Crypto longs lost $404M in four hours as bitcoin dipped below $80K; spot ETFs saw $773M in outflows after three days of inflows.
